blockers: NativeProcessRunner can leave a child process alive when the caller cancellation token is canceled; see src/FactorioManager.Api/NativeRuntime.cs:101-115.

evidence.outcome: NativeProcessRunner links the caller token, but cancellation cleanup only handles timeout cancellation when the caller token is not canceled; caller cancellation can propagate without killing/waiting for the child.
Missing executable and required base/space-age prototype directories fail readiness closed; test passes.
Jobs use unique native-jobs directories and disposal removes only the job directory; isolation/disposal test passes.
Verifier requires PNG signature and hashes complete bytes; repeated verification returns the same SHA-256 and length.
dotnet test --no-restore: 73 passed, 0 failed; dotnet build --no-restore: succeeded.

next_slice.summary: Fix NativeProcessRunner cancellation cleanup, then rerun QA; add integration coverage proving native arguments and disposal cannot target production paths.

result: Runtime absence detection, disposable job creation, PNG signature/hash verification, route boundary, and UI boundary were verified. Full backend tests passed 73/73 and solution build passed. Acceptance is blocked because caller cancellation can leave the native child process running.
